subject: general
question: Mahatma Gandhi organized a Satyagraha to support the peasants of Kheda. Kheda district is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Kheda Satyagraha** of **1918** was a significant movement in the Indian independence struggle, organized by **Mahatma Gandhi** to support the peasants of the **Kheda** district in **Gujarat**.
 
• The region was hit by a severe **famine** and a **plague epidemic** in **1917-18**, which led to a total crop failure, yet the British authorities refused to waive the **land revenue** taxes.
 
• According to the government's own **Revenue Code**, farmers were entitled to a full remission of taxes if the yield was less than **one-fourth** of the normal production.
 
• **Gandhi** launched the **Satyagraha** (non-violent resistance) and urged the farmers to refuse tax payments despite the government seizing their property, cattle, and lands.
 
• The movement was a major success as the government finally agreed to suspend the tax for the year and return the confiscated property, establishing **Gandhi** as a powerful leader for the rural masses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**:

 
 
• A prominent lawyer from **Gujarat**, Patel was deeply influenced by **Gandhi** during the **Kheda Satyagraha** and gave up his legal practice to join the freedom movement full-time.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Champaran (1917)**:
 
 
• While **Champaran** in **Bihar** was Gandhi's first Satyagraha involving indigo farmers, the **Kheda** movement was the first major peasant-based non-cooperation struggle in **Western India**.
 
 
 
• **Other Major Movements in Gujarat**:
 
 
• **Ahmedabad Mill Strike (1918)**: Focused on industrial workers' wages and was Gandhi's first **hunger strike** in India.
 
• **Bardoli Satyagraha (1928)**: Another successful peasant movement in **Gujarat** led by **Sardar Patel** against a 30 percent tax hike.
 
 
 
• **The Philosophy of Satyagraha**:
 
 
• The term was coined by Gandhi to represent a method of non-violent resistance based on **Truth** and **Ahimsa** (non-violence), which he had previously tested in **South Africa**.
